nodes.description: address public creatorAddress in AccessControl; owner address set to msg.sender in constructor and used by onlyCREATOR.
uint16 public totalSeraphims in AccessControl; incremented/decremented with unchecked 0.4.x arithmetic (unbounded loop-free but overflow/underflow reachable).
mapping(address => bool) public seraphims in AccessControl; privileged role mapping checked by onlySERAPHIM.
bool public isMaintenanceMode in AccessControl; defaults true, gates contract activity via isContractActive.
uint8 public totalAngelCardSeries declared in interface IAngelCardData.
uint64 public totalAngels declared in interface IAngelCardData.
address public angelCardDataContract in BattleCooldown, hardcoded to 0x6D2E76213615925c5fc436565B5ee788Ee0E86DC and used as the target of external calls.
uint32 public bestAngel in BattleCooldown, used as the experience reference for battle cooldown tiers.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller used for ownership assignment and for all access-control modifiers.
Miner-influenced block data (block.blockhash(block.number-1) / block.number) consumed as entropy in getRandomNumber; treated as a timestamp/block-value dependency.
AccessControl() constructor: assigns creatorAddress = msg.sender.
addSERAPHIM(address _newSeraphim) onlyCREATOR: grants the seraphim role and increments totalSeraphims.
removeSERAPHIM(address _oldSeraphim) onlyCREATOR: revokes the seraphim role and decrements totalSeraphims.
updateMaintenanceMode(bool _isMaintaining) onlyCREATOR: toggles isMaintenanceMode.
modifier onlyCREATOR: require(msg.sender == creatorAddress) — the single privileged-access gate.
modifier onlySERAPHIM: require(seraphims[msg.sender] == true) — role-based gate.
modifier isContractActive: require(!isMaintenanceMode) — declared but never applied to any function.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint x, uint y) pure internal: z = x + y with an overflow assert.
SafeMath.safeSubtract(uint x, uint y) pure internal: assert(x >= y); z = x - y.
SafeMath.safeMult(uint x, uint y) pure internal: z = x * y with an overflow assert.
getRandomNumber(uint16 maxRandom, uint8 min, address privateAddress) constant public: derives a pseudo-random uint8 from block data and a user-supplied address.
BattleCooldown.setBestAngel(uint32 _bestAngel) onlySERAPHIM external: writes bestAngel.
BattleCooldown.getBestAngel() constant public: returns bestAngel.
BattleCooldown.getBattleCooldown(uint64 angelID) constant public: reads angel experience through an external call and returns one of five fixed cooldown tiers.
BattleCooldown.getNextBattleTime(uint64 angelId) constant public: reads last battle time externally and adds the cooldown.
totalSeraphims += 1 in addSERAPHIM — unchecked 16-bit increment in Solidity 0.4.17.
totalSeraphims -= 1 in removeSERAPHIM — unchecked 16-bit decrement (underflow to 65535 possible).
uint z = x + y inside safeAdd; guarded only by assert.
uint z = x - y inside safeSubtract; guarded only by assert(x >= y).
uint z = x * y inside safeMult; guarded only by assert((x == 0)||(z/x == y)).
return uint8(genNum % (maxRandom - min + 1) + min) in getRandomNumber — arithmetic on unchecked operands plus predictable randomness; also implicitly truncates to uint8.
External call IAngelCardData(angelCardDataContract).getAngel(angelID) inside getBattleCooldown, executed against a state-stored contract address.
External call IAngelCardData(angelCardDataContract).getAngel(angelId) inside getNextBattleTime.
return (angellastBattleTime + getBattleCooldown(angelId)) — unchecked uint addition of externally supplied time data.
Parameter _newSeraphim of addSERAPHIM; used to key the seraphims mapping.
Parameter _oldSeraphim of removeSERAPHIM; used to key the seraphims mapping.
Parameter _isMaintaining of updateMaintenanceMode; written into isMaintenanceMode.
Parameter x of safeAdd.
Parameter y of safeAdd.
Local variable z in safeAdd holding the addition result.
Parameter x of safeSubtract.
Parameter y of safeSubtract.
Local variable z in safeSubtract holding the subtraction result.
Parameter x of safeMult.
Parameter y of safeMult.
Local variable z in safeMult holding the multiplication result.
Parameter maxRandom of getRandomNumber; upper bound of the modulo range.
Parameter min of getRandomNumber; lower bound of the modulo range.
Parameter privateAddress of getRandomNumber; caller-supplied value mixed into the entropy.
Local variable genNum in getRandomNumber = uint256(block.blockhash(block.number-1)) + uint256(privateAddress).
Parameter _bestAngel of setBestAngel; written into bestAngel.
Parameter angelID of getBattleCooldown; used to query angel data.
Local variable experience in getBattleCooldown, destructured from the external getAngel call.
Local interface instance angelCardData in getBattleCooldown, cast from angelCardDataContract.
Parameter angelId of getNextBattleTime.
Local variable angellastBattleTime in getNextBattleTime, destructured from the external getAngel call.
Local interface instance angelCardData in getNextBattleTime, cast from angelCardDataContract.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored into creatorAddress, establishing the owner.
The constructor executes the creatorAddress assignment.
onlyCREATOR consumes msg.sender as the authorization subject.
creatorAddress is compared with msg.sender inside onlyCREATOR.
onlySERAPHIM uses msg.sender as the lookup key for the role mapping.
seraphims[msg.sender] is read to decide whether the caller is privileged.
onlyCREATOR gates entry into addSERAPHIM.
onlyCREATOR gates entry into removeSERAPHIM.
onlyCREATOR gates entry into updateMaintenanceMode.
onlySERAPHIM gates entry into setBestAngel.
isContractActive reads isMaintenanceMode to decide whether the contract is usable.
_newSeraphim is consumed by addSERAPHIM.
seraphims[_newSeraphim] is set to true.
addSERAPHIM executes the totalSeraphims += 1 operation.
current totalSeraphims value feeds the increment.
the incremented value is written back to totalSeraphims.
_oldSeraphim is consumed by removeSERAPHIM.
seraphims[_oldSeraphim] is set to false.
removeSERAPHIM executes the totalSeraphims -= 1 operation.
current totalSeraphims value feeds the decrement.
the decremented value is written back to totalSeraphims.
_isMaintaining is consumed by updateMaintenanceMode.
_isMaintaining is written into the isMaintenanceMode state variable.
parameter x is bound to safeAdd.
parameter y is bound to safeAdd.
safeAdd executes the addition operation.
x is an operand of the addition.
y is an operand of the addition.
the addition result is stored in local z.
parameter x is bound to safeSubtract.
parameter y is bound to safeSubtract.
safeSubtract executes the subtraction operation.
x is the minuend of the subtraction.
y is the subtrahend of the subtraction.
the subtraction result is stored in local z.
parameter x is bound to safeMult.
parameter y is bound to safeMult.
safeMult executes the multiplication operation.
x is an operand of the multiplication.
y is an operand of the multiplication.
the multiplication result is stored in local z.
maxRandom is bound to getRandomNumber.
min is bound to getRandomNumber.
privateAddress is bound to getRandomNumber.
block.blockhash(block.number-1) (miner-influenced block value) is used as entropy for genNum.
privateAddress is added into genNum.
genNum is the dividend of the modulo expression.
maxRandom participates in the (maxRandom - min + 1) computation.
min participates in the (maxRandom - min + 1) computation and the final addition.
getRandomNumber computes and returns the truncated modulo result.
_bestAngel is bound to setBestAngel.
_bestAngel is written into bestAngel.
setBestAngel performs the write to the bestAngel state variable.
getBestAngel reads bestAngel.
angelID is bound to getBattleCooldown.
angelCardDataContract supplies the target address of the external getAngel call.
getBattleCooldown performs the external call, handing control to an external contract.
the local angelCardData interface instance is used to invoke getAngel.
the experience value returned by the external call is stored in local experience.
bestAngel is subtracted from experience through safeSubtract, driving the cooldown tiers.
externally reported experience is an operand of safeSubtract.
getBattleCooldown repeatedly calls safeSubtract to compare tiers.
angelId is bound to getNextBattleTime.
angelCardDataContract supplies the target address of the external getAngel call.
getNextBattleTime performs the external call, handing control to an external contract.
the local angelCardData interface instance is used to invoke getAngel.
the last-battle-time value returned by the external call is stored in local angellastBattleTime.
angellastBattleTime is an operand of the unchecked addition.
getNextBattleTime computes last battle time plus cooldown.
the cooldown returned by getBattleCooldown is added into the result.
getNextBattleTime calls getBattleCooldown.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter is only meaningful inside addSERAPHIM, where it keys the seraphims mapping.
The parameter is only meaningful inside removeSERAPHIM, where it keys the seraphims mapping.
The parameter is a plain value written to isMaintenanceMode by updateMaintenanceMode.
x only exists as an operand of the addition guarded by safeAdd.
y only exists as an operand of the addition guarded by safeAdd.
z is the temporary result of the unsafe addition operation in safeAdd.
x only exists as the minuend inside safeSubtract.
y only exists as the subtrahend inside safeSubtract.
z is the temporary result of the unsafe subtraction operation in safeSubtract.
x only exists as an operand of the multiplication in safeMult.
y only exists as an operand of the multiplication in safeMult.
z is the temporary result of the unsafe multiplication operation in safeMult.
maxRandom is a bound used only by the getRandomNumber range computation.
min is a bound used only by the getRandomNumber range computation.
privateAddress is caller-supplied entropy consumed only by getRandomNumber.
genNum is the intermediate entropy value consumed by the modulo expression in getRandomNumber.
_bestAngel is a plain value written into bestAngel by setBestAngel.
angelID is only used as the query key for the external getAngel call from getBattleCooldown.
experience is the destructured output of the external getAngel call in getBattleCooldown.
the local interface instance exists solely to perform the external getAngel call in getBattleCooldown.
angelId is only used to query the external contract and to call getBattleCooldown.
angellastBattleTime is the externally supplied operand of the addition returned by getNextBattleTime.
the local interface instance exists solely to perform the external getAngel call in getNextBattleTime.
